text: Dev's first real session with Coda turned into an unexpected lesson: while Jordan marks moments that felt good, Dev marked eleven moments that went wrong, treating the app as a bug tracker for a gig on the 19th rather than the "highlight reel" Jordan designed. Jordan felt a mix of surprise and quiet realization, recognizing they'd built the app around their own emotional need to collect evidence of being okay, never accounting for someone practicing toward a deadline. Jordan decided the fix isn't separate modes but making marks neutral by default, letting the review step ask what each moment actually was — meanwhile Dev found real value anyway, spotting a longtime crutch and drilling their worst passage until it improved, with Pepper offering her own commentary throughout.
